page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core allocation. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results position this instance primarily in the average performance tier for multi-core operations, while single-core performance is relatively weak. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test, PassMark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all fall within the middle 50% of tested servers. Conversely, single-threaded tasks show limitations, with stress-ng single-core performance in the bottom 25% and gzip compression in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth is stable, with uncached read and write speeds averaging 77.7 GB/sec and 59.92 GB/sec respectively.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge offers a standard resource density profile suitable for general-purpose workloads. It performs reliably on database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving, all of which score in the average tier. However, the lack of local storage and weak single-core performance make it less suitable for high-performance computing or I/O-intensive database tasks. It is best utilized for medium-scale web applications, enterprise application servers, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks.
